scenarios.observation: Page loaded; #hud reached data-ready=true in 1.4s with no page errors.
Loading bar reached 100% and the platform ready signal fired once.
Clicked Play on the title screen; the first run began and the score read 0.
Pressed ArrowLeft at 00:03; the ship moved one lane left.
Passed four gates on the beat; the combo counter rose to 4.
A run ending at 1200 replaced the personal best of 800.
Missed a gate deliberately; the game-over panel appeared with the final score.
Clicked Retry; a new run started within one second at score 0.
Hid the page; the loop stopped stepping. Showed it; stepping resumed from the same frame count.
At 393x851 the canvas filled the viewport and the Play button was tappable.
